lines.text: Many learners say: I am tired, I want to sleep.
Better: I am tired, so I want to sleep.
Add so to join the two parts.
So! I am tired, so I want to sleep.

data.wrong: I am tired, I want to sleep.
data.right: I am tired, so I want to sleep.
data.why: Add so to join the two parts.

quiz.stem: I am tired, ___ I want to sleep.

native.hook: 两句话之间不能只用逗号！
native.tip: 中文可以用逗号一路连下去。英语里两句完整的话中间，只用逗号连起来是错的，要加 so 这样的词，或者用句号。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I am tired, I want to sleep.”😅 中文逗号可以连很多句，英语要加 so：“I am tired, so I want to sleep.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I am tired, so I want to sleep.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.hook: You can’t just use commas between
en.tip: Chinese can join full sentences with commas, but English cannot.
en.caption: Do you say “I am tired, I want to sleep.” 😅 English cannot join full sentences with just a comma: “I am tired, so I want to sleep.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
